address: 10 Nguyen Thanh Y Street, Tan Dinh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Vietnam's first zero-waste, plant-based fine dining concept, this serene villa setting serves seasonal tasting menus based on local produce, rooftop-grown herbs and fermentation. Diners can see dishes being crafted at the chef's counter, such as corn pie tee – crisp cups of soy-corn purée, charred kernels, kimchi and fermented chilli – and chewy porcini-filled rice dumpling cake in a reimagined bánh bột lọc. Wine pairings, with or without alcohol, top off the experience.
